mapper.select: select t.*, c.name as category_name, pc.name as parent_category_name, c.parent_seq as parent_category_seq from tbl_talent t inner join tbl_category c on c.category_seq = t.category_seq left join tbl_category pc on pc.category_seq = c.parent_seq where t.talent_seq = #{talentSeq} and t.enabled = 'Y'

select p.*, (select count(*) from tbl_portfolio_image pi where pi.portfolio_seq = p.portfolio_seq) as image_count, (select pi.file_name from tbl_portfolio_image pi where pi.portfolio_seq = p.portfolio_seq and pi.slot = 1) as thumbnail from tbl_talent_portfolio tp inner join tbl_portfolio p on p.portfolio_seq = tp.portfolio_seq where tp.talent_seq = #{talentSeq} order by tp.slot
mapper.insert:
select seq_talent.nextval from dual
insert into tbl_talent (talent_seq, expert_seq, category_seq, title, content, price) values (#{talentSeq}, #{expertSeq}, #{categorySeq}, #{title}, #{content}, #{price})
insert into tbl_talent_portfolio (talent_seq, portfolio_seq, slot) values (#{talentSeq}, #{portfolioSeq}, #{slot})
mapper.select: select count(*) from tbl_category where category_seq = #{categorySeq} and parent_seq is not null and enabled = 'Y'
